items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, one of the co-leaders of The World's Greatest Jazz Band. ... Dick Gibson formed - ten of the guys were there, Bob Haggart Mank Lawson, Bob Wilber and some of the rest and they formed the World's Greatest Jazz Band.

ctx.x: Yeah, one of the co-leaders of The World's Greatest Jazz Band.
And I noticed that they had George Duvivier on bass instead of Bob Haggart. He may have been out of town, or something.
But most of these guys were with The World's Greatest Jazz Band, you know, that I joined after I finished an engagement with Bobby Hackett.
